The '''Mission in the Dellalt system''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] reconnaissance mission flown by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in the [[Dellalt system/Legends|Dellalt system]]. He revealed the outbreak of [[Operation Strike Fear]].

==Prelude==
During a raid to [[Battle in the Dellalt system|destroy]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] corvette ''[[Bixby]]'' was secured for the Alliance. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nogdra]] of the ''Bixby'' brought intelligence of an Imperial rendezvous point near [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] for a major offensive known as [[Operation Strike Fear]].

==The battle==
Farlander was selected to conduct a reconnaissance flight in a lone [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]]. The pilot passed through the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] and confirmed the presence of a large Imperial force led by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']]. Thanks to the speed of this new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], he managed to identify the [[ID profile]]s of all of the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] without being intercepted.

==Aftermath==
Aware of the presence of the Imperial fleet in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] ordered the [[Battle of Brigia (Galactic Civil War)|evacuation]] of the [[Brigia Rebel base|Rebel base]] on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]].
